scope: Bounded read-only source research, US roadtrip attraction planning; no records admitted, no repository changes or production writes.
count_semantics: API assets, sites and rows are candidate volumes, not net-new attractions. First/offset samples are non-random diagnostic checks, not acceptance-rate estimates.
